pages.html:
Home/FAQ

FAQ

How is the pass guarantee defined?

Complete the plan and score 70% on the final mocks. If you still fail, your access extends free.

Are the exam fees included?

No. Exam fees are paid to the certifying body.

Can my employer pay?

Yes, we issue invoices and can provide a progress report.
